prompt: 我的客服 Agent 已经上线了，但最近发现它在长对话（20+ 轮）中越来越不靠谱，经常忘记之前的对话内容，有时候还会重复问用户已经回答过的问题。我需要一个监控方案来检测和预防这种退化。

assertions.description: Defines context health metrics (utilization rate, reference freshness, coherence score)
Includes an algorithm or heuristic for detecting context degradation (not just monitoring)
Defines specific alert thresholds with numeric values (not vague 'if high')
Provides a dashboard layout with specific panels/widgets
Sets a Mean Time to Detect target (e.g., <5 minutes)
